prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1347; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with pain and swelling of the left wrist. Physical examination showed tenderness over the distal radius with restricted range of motion, and radiographs confirmed a distal radius fracture. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the injury observed. No prior injury or treatment to this body area is known from the patient's history or available records. Care was provided over seven visits and followed a typical course: immobilization in a splint, serial clinical checks, progressive range-of-motion exercises, and gradual reduction in visit frequency as symptoms resolved and function improved. Billed services corresponded to the visits documented, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified. At the most recent visit the fracture was noted to be healing as expected, and the patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms worsen.
